activity.notes: Laplace published the first volumes of Traité de Mécanique Céleste in 1799 and his Théorie analytique des probabilités in 1812, with a substantial second edition in 1814. The 1799–1814 year-level span represents major publications in celestial mechanics and probability; it does not imply the end of his mathematical career.
